title: House / Atlas Systems and Information Theory Research
purpose: Preserve candidate systems-theoretic, information-theoretic, graph-theoretic, logical and organizational formalisms that may sharpen the existing House/Atlas without replacing its architecture.
scope_rule: Use formalism only when it improves a real problem in ownership, projection, retrieval, navigation, provenance, validation, composition, time, maintenance or reader orientation. Mathematical resemblance is not empirical, causal, theological or metaphysical proof.

components.T_N: selected rooted North arborescence for canonical orientation
components.E_B: broader-context graph allowing several legitimate contexts

formal_house_model.key_resolution: One North can remain simple because the canonical North tree is only an orientation structure embedded in richer broader-context, relation, provenance and temporal graphs.

candidate_principles: Match complexity in the backend; compress complexity at the interface.
Every View is a lossy channel; declare what it is allowed to lose.
Good architecture compresses repetition without compressing distinctions.
Centrality is always centrality under a graph definition.
Composition should happen at interfaces, not by erasing boundaries.
A healthy system requires enough sensors to observe the failures it claims to regulate.
Make impossible states difficult to represent.
When it happened, when we learned it, and when we interpreted it are different clocks.
Know not only where a claim came from, but what process turned it into the current representation.
Dependency knowledge should power both provenance and incremental builds.
Mountain and Tree are inverse navigation directions, not necessarily inverse functions.
Experiment in reversible Views; mutate canonical identity conservatively.
Swamp is a diagnostic vector; Garden is a viability region.
One source of truth does not require one point of operational failure.
Do not let folders become a theory of the world.
Search relevance, graph relevance, navigation relevance and canonical ownership are different objectives.
The system learns only if contradiction can change the model.
Health metrics should diagnose, not become isolated targets.
The House is a regulated compression/expansion machine.
high_value_low_risk_candidates: North arborescence plus broader-context graph distinction
relation type contracts and causal-status firewall
research_only_until_needed: Hodge decomposition outside dimensioned quantitative flows
red_team: Do not introduce mathematics merely because it resembles Potatoverse vocabulary.
Do not infer truth from centrality, PageRank, clusters or visual proximity.
Do not call a graph causal without causal assumptions and evidence.
Do not treat Mountain compression as lossless.
Do not use entropy without defining a probability/coding model.
Do not use control theory without defining state, observations, controls, constraints and objectives.
Do not promote exploratory research into architecture until it solves a repeated concrete problem.
promotion_rule: Promote only when an idea solves a repeated real problem, connects cleanly to an existing owner or contract, survives cross-domain counterexamples, and can be observed, validated or implemented without creating a competing architecture.
expanded_notebook: Local research artifact HOUSE-ATLAS-SYSTEMS-INFORMATION-THEORY-2026-09-13.md contains the long-form reasoning and counterarguments.
